require "thinkthen"

# the outage first, then the Friday quote, then the bill
# due in a month, and the newsletter last
inbox = ["Newsletter: our autumn catalog is here. No reply needed.",
  "Our checkout page is down and customers cannot pay",
  "Reminder: your invoice is due in 30 days",
  "Please send the signed quote by Friday"]
ThinkThen.rank("Does this need an answer today?", inbox)
  .each { |one| puts one.record }
